product.title: PDRN Pink Collagen Gel Toner Pad
product.body_html:
OVERVIEW

Bouncy Collagen Gel Pads boost the delivery of ultra-low molecular collagen (200Da), which penetrates deep into the skin to help restore elasticity. Gentle yet effective formula that delivers lasting hydration and natural glow, targeting uneven skin tone & dark spot

What is PDRN?
  • Salmon DNA PDRN Salmon PDRN is a form of DNA extracted from salmon. The extraction process isolates small DNA fragments that are highly compatible with human skin cells due to their structural similarity to human DNA. This compatibility enhances the skin's natural barrier, making it stronger and more resilient.

    *The above information pertains only to the characteristics of the raw materials

CLINICAL TEST
  • Immediate hydration boost
    +9.3% surface hydration in just 5 seconeds
    +37.2% Skin Glow in Just 5 Seconds
    Improve Skin Elasticity
    +1.85% Forehead improved in 2 weeks
    +1.84% Frown lines improved in 2 weeks
    +1.33% Smile lines improved in 2 weeks
    Improve dark spot and hyperpigmentation
    3.23% dark spot and hyperpigmentation improved in 2 weeks

    *Clinical Trial Tested by the 'Global Institute of Dermatological Sciences' / Results may vary depending on individual skin types.

HOW TO USE
  • Step 1. Open the package that has the Salmon DNA PDRN essence
  • Step 2. Pour the PDRN essence into the container
  • Step 3. Wait for 5 seconds for the pad to turn in to a bouncy collagen gel
  • Step 4. Apply on targeted area for soothing and cooling effect
FAQ
  • Q. What are the main benefits of the PDRN Pink Collagen Jelly Pads? The jelly toner pads provide soothing hydration while helping improve the appearance of uneven skin tone and texture. With Salmon DNA PDRN and Collagen, they leave skin looking smoother, plumper, and naturally radiant.
  • Q. What makes these different from regular toner pads? Unlike traditional cotton toner pads, these feature a bouncy jelly gel texture designed to fit closely against the skin. The Micro-Skin Fit design allows them to be used as a quick 5-minute targeted mask before gently wiping the skin with the pads.
  • Q. How long should I wait after pouring in the essence? After pouring the essence into the pouch, wait approximately 5 seconds to allow the jelly pads to absorb the formula before applying them to the skin.
  • Q. Can I use these pads like a face mask? Yes. The Micro-Skin Fit jelly pads can be placed on targeted areas for 5 minutes to provide concentrated hydration and soothing care before using them to gently wipe the skin.
  • Q. Who are these jelly pads best for? They're ideal for skin concerned with dryness, dullness, uneven skin tone, rough texture, or lack of radiance, especially for those looking for quick targeted hydration and soothing care.
